sketches.mechanism: Ownership is moved when a value is passed by value; using the old binding afterward is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: What is given completely cannot also remain in the giver's hands.

sketches.mechanism: An empty inductive type has no constructors, so pattern matching on it requires no cases and can produce any type.
sketches.resonance: From an impossible witness, every answer is vacuously available, yet none can ever be asked for.
sketches.draft:
Inductive NoOne : Set := .

Definition answer (n : NoOne) : nat :=
  match n with end.

sketches.mechanism: A weak reference does not retain its object and is automatically set to nil when the last strong reference leaves scope.
sketches.resonance: A memory that refuses to possess what it remembers must watch it disappear.
